extracted.description: Estimate the total count of major altitude change events for satellite 48445 during the full year 2024, based on TLE history.
A major altitude change is strictly defined as an altitude change greater than 1000m occurring within a 12-hour interval.
Altitude at each TLE epoch must be estimated using skifield's itrf_xyz applied to the TLE history.
The TLE history basis must adequately cover satellite 48445 across 2024 so that the estimated count reflects the whole year.

stored.description: Estimate the total count of major altitude change events for satellite 48445 during the full year 2024, based on TLE history.
acceptanceCriteria: The final result is a single numeric total count of qualifying altitude-change events for satellite 48445 in 2024.
The count is scoped exclusively to satellite 48445.
The count covers the entire 2024 calendar year, not a partial-year subset.

assertions.description: Estimate the total count of major altitude change events for satellite 48445 during the full year 2024, based on TLE history.

stored.description: A major altitude change is strictly defined as an altitude change greater than 1000m occurring within a 12-hour interval.
acceptanceCriteria: Only altitude differences strictly exceeding 1000m between TLE epochs no more than 12 hours apart qualify as events.
Altitude changes of 1000m or less, or measured over intervals longer than 12 hours, are excluded from the count.
Each qualifying event contributes exactly once to the total; no double counting and no counting of non-qualifying transitions.

assertions.description: A major altitude change is strictly defined as an altitude change greater than 1000m occurring within a 12-hour interval.

stored.description: Altitude at each TLE epoch must be estimated using skifield's itrf_xyz applied to the TLE history.
acceptanceCriteria: Altitude per TLE epoch is derived by converting/propagating the TLE via skifield's itrf_xyz and computing altitude from the resulting position vector.
No alternative altitude source or precomputed altitude value is substituted for the itrf_xyz-derived estimate.

assertions.description: Altitude at each TLE epoch must be estimated using skifield's itrf_xyz applied to the TLE history.

stored.description: The TLE history basis must adequately cover satellite 48445 across 2024 so that the estimated count reflects the whole year.
acceptanceCriteria: The computation relies only on TLE history records for satellite 48445 within 2024.
The >1000m within 12h rule is applied uniformly across the year, and data coverage limitations do not silently relax or tighten the event definition.

assertions.description: The TLE history basis must adequately cover satellite 48445 across 2024 so that the estimated count reflects the whole year.
